pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions are irregularly polygonal with smooth-to-moderate pixel gradients at the edges; spatial area of patches is significantly larger on the neck and shoulder, becoming smaller and more sub-ovate toward the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-toned negative space forming a interconnected grid; junction nodes are primarily tri-valent intersections; pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank with localized widening at the dorsal-cervical transition.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane exhibits a continuous serrated silhouette with high-frequency, low-amplitude jaggedness along the visible neck and shoulder line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple thin, linear, horizontal, and diagonal light-pigmented streaks are visible on the central flank, indicative of superficial scarring or skin folds.
other_distinctive_markers: Two small birds (oxpeckers) are perched on the upper dorsal ridge/shoulder area, creating localized visual occlusion.
